analogy.rationale: Leukotriene synthesis inhibitors block LTA4H/RNPEP in the arachidonic acid cascade, so lipoxygenase inhibitors (upstream) and leukotriene receptor antagonists (same pathway) should give the most similar responses, though these cells' limited leukotriene pathway expression makes overall effects weak.
